title: Structural Characteristics of Theragra chalcogramma Milt Peptides and Their Anti-Fatigue Activity via AMPK/PGC-1alphaMediated Energy Metabolism Regulation in Exercised Mice.
authors: Zhang, Jiangjiang; Ding, Yulian; Zhang, Shanshan; Yang, Tingting; Fan, Chaozhong; Zhu, Xiaoyun; Hou, Hu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鱼类精巢肽的抗疲劳活性及AMPK/PGC-1α能量代谢通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Objectives: While several physiological functions of milt peptides have been discovered, the structural characteristics of Theragra chalcogramma milt peptides (TMP) and their anti-fatigue mechanisms remain unclear. Methods: TMP was obtained by hydrolysis via flavor enzyme and alkaline protease, and its structural characteristics were analyzed. A mice model of exercise-induced fatigue was established. The anti-fatigue effect of TMP was evaluated by determining the main biochemical indices in the serum, liver, and skeletal muscle of mice. Additionally, qPCR analysis was conducted to investigate its regulatory effects on relevant energy metabolism pathways. Results: TMP contained 18.2% branched-chain amino acids, with those with molecular weights below 1000 Da accounting for 91.6%. A total of 154 characteristic peptides, such as VPFPR and LPPGR, were identified from TMP, among which 64% of the peptides contained glutamic acid, arginine, or aspartic acid. Molecular docking of potential bioactive peptides to AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) revealed binding energies from -9.1 to -5.5 kcal/mol. The exhaustive swimming test showed that oral administration of TMP prolonged the swimming duration. In the fatigue murine model, TMP reduced blood urea nitrogen and blood lactic acid levels while enhancing the content of muscle glycogen. Meanwhile, TMP significantly increased the activity of glutathione peroxidase and superoxide dismutase and reduced the accumulation of malondialdehyde, demonstrating antioxidant properties. Additionally, TMP significantly decreased creatine kinase and lactate dehydrogenase extravasation, thereby protecting muscle tissue, as corroborated by immunohistochemical analyses. Mechanistically, TMP upregulated AMPK and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator-1alpha (PGC-1alpha) expression, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis via the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway. Conclusions: These findings suggest TMP has potential as a dietary supplement for alleviating physical fatigue.
abstract_zh: 目的：尽管已发现鱼类精巢肽的多种生理功能，但狭鳕（Theragra chalcogramma）精巢肽（TMP）的结构特征及其抗疲劳机制仍不清楚。方法：通过风味酶和碱性蛋白酶水解获得TMP，并分析其结构特征。建立运动性疲劳小鼠模型。通过测定小鼠血清、肝脏和骨骼肌中的主要生化指标，评估TMP的抗疲劳效果。此外，采用qPCR分析研究其对相关能量代谢途径的调节作用。结果：TMP含有18.2%的支链氨基酸，其中分子量低于1000 Da的肽占91.6%。从TMP中鉴定出共154种特征肽，如VPFPR和LPPGR，其中64%的肽含有谷氨酸、精氨酸或天冬氨酸。潜在生物活性肽与AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）的分子对接显示结合能为-9.1至-5.5 kcal/mol。力竭游泳测试表明，口服TMP延长了游泳持续时间。在疲劳小鼠模型中，TMP降低了血尿素氮和血乳酸水平，同时提高了肌糖原含量。此外，TMP显著增加了谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶和超氧化物歧化酶的活性，并减少了丙二醛的积累，显示出抗氧化特性。同时，TMP显著降低了肌酸激酶和乳酸脱氢酶的外渗，从而保护肌肉组织，这通过免疫组化分析得到证实。机制上，TMP上调了AMPK和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子-1α（PGC-1alpha）的表达，通过AMPK/PGC-1alpha途径促进线粒体生物发生。结论：这些发现表明TMP作为缓解体力疲劳的膳食补充剂具有潜力。
